data.title: Ethereum challenges $2,550 resistance as ETF in... | Pluang
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) has bounced back from a recent selloff and is testing the $2,500–$2,550 resistance zone, a key level it has struggled to surpass. This time, renewed inflows into U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs, totaling about $66.4 million on September 18, signal growing institutional interest after several days of outflows. If ETH can sustain a move above $2,550, it may open the way to higher targets at $2,700, $2,800, and potentially the psychological $3,000 level. Additionally, with around 35% of ETH staked and thus less liquid, supply constraints could support price gains. However, confirmation of the breakout is crucial to avoid a reversal back into the current range.
data.author: Coinpaper
